purpose: Non-benchmark compatibility check of fixed-shape CUDA graph replay over frozen Qwen restricted readout, without replacing attention kernels.
changes: Unmerged LoRA and native backbone retained. Call text model with use_cache=False, native full/recurrent masks computed outside capture, default-equivalent explicit positions, static input/allowed-option/mask buffers. Warm up on a side stream, capture once, replay original/reversed/original batch order with fresh input copies.
acceptance: Four fixed interface cases repeated in three orders. Relative to full-vocabulary original forward require argmax >= 0.99, max probability delta <= 0.04 and mean TV <= 0.005. Relative to identical uncaptured mapped/cache-off forward require max delta <= 0.00001. No thresholds relaxed after results.
scope: Only compatibility. A pass cannot establish 1390-decision validation parity, speed, gates or production suitability. Any eventual timing must include preprocessing and buffer/mask updates under original laptop conditions.
compute: Local shared run_heavy lock, four threads, process-local hot=80/cool=76/every=0 thermal guard with 60-second timeout, wrapper max_gpu_c=84. Original hardware-throttle/free-memory safeguards. No cloud or paid endpoint. Worker deadline unchanged.
resource_amendment: Before any execution of this plan, tighten process-local thermal pacing to hot=80 C/cool=76 C before every call and run_heavy max_gpu_c=84 C after confirmed Windows host reboot with bugcheck 0x20001. Cause is not established. Model, inputs, probability limits and quality criteria are unchanged.
recovery: The first attempt stopped before inference on missing cache text metadata. The same pinned snapshot now passes offline lookup with all ten original files unchanged. Worker source differs only in output-directory and registration constants. Four cases, model, cache/masks, graph algorithm, numerical limits, resource envelope and time bounds are unchanged.
